entities.name: Biblioplex
entities.description: The vast library at the center of Strixhaven University, said to hold the knowledge of the Multiverse and the most complete archive of magic.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The university on Arcavios whose campus the Biblioplex rises above.

entities.name: Isabough
entities.description: The Treefolk librarian of the Biblioplex, aided by constructs and gargoyles.

entities.name: Codie
entities.description: A chattering animated book that roams the Biblioplex halls.

entities.name: Hall of Oracles
entities.description: A hallowed chamber at the center of the Biblioplex that was ruined in the Oriq attack.

entities.name: Oriq Attack on Strixhaven
entities.description: The attack during which Extus Narr infiltrated the Biblioplex.

entities.name: Extus Narr
entities.description: An Oriq who infiltrated the Biblioplex and summoned the Blood Avatar.

entities.name: Blood Avatar
entities.description: A being summoned in the Hall of Oracles and defeated by the Kenriths.

entities.name: Rowan Kenrith
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped defeat Extus Narr and the Blood Avatar.

entities.name: Will Kenrith
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped defeat Extus Narr and the Blood Avatar.

entities.name: Invocation of the Founders
entities.description: A spell housed in a small chamber of the library, used during the New Phyrexian Invasion to create a massive fractal tree.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion during which the Invocation of the Founders was used.

entities.name: Arick Quenthorne
entities.description: A great elven scholar and Strixhaven Director who donated the first holdings of the Scriptoria Collections.

entities.name: Founder Dragons
entities.description: Strixhaven's founders, who with perhaps the Oracle of Arcavios knew how the Biblioplex worked.

events.summary: During the Oriq attack Extus Narr infiltrates the Biblioplex and summons the Blood Avatar in the Hall of Oracles.
events.quote: During the Oriq Attack on Strixhaven , Extus Narr infiltrated the Biblioplex and summoned the Blood Avatar in the Hall of Oracles.

events.summary: Rowan and Will Kenrith defeat Extus Narr and the Blood Avatar, but the Hall of Oracles collapses.
events.quote: Extus Narr and the Blood Avatar were defeated by Rowan and Will Kenrith , but the Hall of Oracles collapsed from the magical strain and was left in ruin.

events.summary: The Invocation of the Founders is used during the Invasion, creating a fractal tree that breaks through the building's ceiling.
events.quote: the spell was housed deep within the library, until it was used during the New Phyrexian Invasion , when a massive fractal tree was created in the chamber's center, breaking through the building's ceiling.

relations.quote: an enormous domed building that rises above the rest of the campus in Strixhaven , Arcavios .

relations.note: Rowan and Will defeated Extus Narr.
